units.source_text: 忽然，沙子的流动加快了。

en.t: Suddenly, the flow of sand quickened.

units.source_text: 橡皮筋般，四下扩散的沉闷声响，绵软无力地向他的胸脯压过来。

en.t: Like a rubber band, the dull sound spreading in all directions pressed softly and weakly against his chest.

units.source_text: 他想看看究竟是怎么回事，竭力往上张望，这时已经分不清哪是上哪是下了。

en.t: He tried to see what was really happening and strained to look upward, but by then he could no longer tell which way was up and which was down.

units.source_text: 叠在一起的黑色呕吐物周围，勾勒出一层模糊的淡乳色晕圈。

en.t: Around the piled-up black vomit, a blurred, pale milky halo was outlined.
